explanation: Eiichiro Oda began the series in 1997 in the magazine Weekly Shōnen Jump. Luffy's stretchy body comes from eating a Devil Fruit, which also leaves him unable to swim.

claims.text: Monkey D. Luffy is the hero of the manga One Piece.
Naruto, Dragon Ball and Bleach are other manga with different heroes.
Eiichiro Oda began One Piece in Weekly Shōnen Jump in 1997.
Luffy's rubbery body comes from eating a Devil Fruit, and eating one leaves a person unable to swim.
